title: Rounding to the nearest ten on a number line
examples: How do I round to the nearest ten?
What is 37 rounded to the nearest 10?

explain.say: Your shopping costs 37 rupees. About how much is that? Rounding helps! Look at the number line: 37 sits between 30 and 40, and just 3 hops take it up to 40.

draw.text: Rounding to the nearest ten on a number line

explain.say: First, find the tens on each side: 30 below and 40 above. 37 is somewhere in between. Which ten do you think is closer?
Count the hops. From 37 up to 40 is only 3 hops. Down to 30 would be 7 hops. 40 is nearer, so 37 rounded to the nearest ten is 40. That is rounding up. Can you see the short jump?
Now try 32. Going back to 30 is just 2 hops, but up to 40 is 8. So 32 rounds down to 30. Which way would 34 go?
Brilliant! 45 is exactly halfway: 5 hops either way. The rule says halfway rounds up, so 45 becomes 50. Wow: news reports round big numbers all the time! Challenge: round 68 and 61.

faq.q: How do I round to the nearest ten?
faq.a: Find the tens just below and just above your number. Whichever is closer wins. 37 is 3 away from 40 and 7 away from 30, so it rounds to 40.

faq.q: What is 37 rounded to the nearest 10?
faq.a: 37 rounds to 40, because 40 is only 3 away, while 30 is 7 away.
A number ending in 5 is exactly halfway between two tens. People agreed on one rule so everyone gets the same answer: halfway rounds up. So 45 rounds to 50.
asks: What happens with numbers ending in 5?

faq.q: How can the ones digit help me round?
faq.a: Look at the ones digit. If it is 0 to 4, round down. If it is 5 to 9, round up. 32 has 2 ones, so it rounds down to 30.
asks: Is there a quick rule for rounding?

faq.a: Rounded numbers are easier to think about and add in your head. Things costing 37 and 32 rupees cost about 40 plus 30, which is 70.

facts: Numbers ending in 0 to 4 round down to the nearest ten, and numbers ending in 5 to 9 round up.

quiz.why: 64 is 4 away from 60 and 6 away from 70, so it rounds to 60.

wrong.0: 70 is farther away: 6 hops instead of 4.
wrong.2: 65 is not a ten; rounding to the nearest ten gives a number ending in 0.

quiz.why: 47 is just 3 away from 50, nearer than 40.

wrong.1: 55 is halfway, so it rounds up to 60.
